cards.text: The book opens by telling you exactly what it is: the revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His servants what must soon come to pass. It's meant for His servant John. But first, somebody has to deliver it.

cards.question: God gave the revelation of Jesus Christ to show His servants what must soon come to pass. Who is sent to make it known to His servant John?

cards.text: John testifies to everything he saw. Not the highlights, not the trailer, friend, the WHOLE thing.

cards.question: True or false: John says what he's sharing is just his own opinion.

cards.text: Before the vision even STARTS, John hands out a blessing to the one who reads this prophecy aloud. No sign-up sheet. No take-a-number machine.

cards.question: John blesses the one who reads this prophecy aloud. Who else does John call blessed?

answers.text: Those who hear and obey it
Those who copy it by hand
Those who learn it by heart

cards.text: John says the time is near, and no, I'm not guessing a date, because Jesus said only the Father knows the day or hour (Matthew 24:36). My job is simple, friend: keep the ovens HOT.
Then John writes like he's starting a letter, to the seven churches in the province of Asia.

cards.question: John sends grace and peace from Him who is and was and is to come, and from the seven spirits before His throne. Who else is it from?

cards.text: John calls Jesus Christ the faithful witness and the firstborn from the dead. Now THAT is a title, friend.

cards.question: True or false: John calls Jesus Christ a servant of the kings of the earth.

cards.text: Then John praises Him who loves us and has released us from our sins by His blood. Friend, I spent years in the dark at the back of a junk drawer, so that word released hits me RIGHT here.

cards.question: Jesus rules the kings of the earth, and John says He has made His people to be a ___, priests to His God and Father.

cards.text: John gives Him the glory and power forever and ever, Amen. And then the big announcement: He is coming with the clouds.

cards.question: True or false: John says every eye will see Jesus when He comes with the clouds.
When Jesus comes with the clouds, John names one group in particular who will see Him. Who?

answers.text: Those who crossed the Red Sea

cards.text: All the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him, and John says so shall it be. Then a different voice speaks up, and it is NOT John's.

cards.question: True or false: The Lord God is the One who says, “I am the Alpha and the Omega.”

cards.text: Now John tells it himself, and he calls himself their brother and partner in the tribulation and kingdom and perseverance that are in Jesus. Translation: John is NOT writing this from a beach chair.

cards.question: John says he was on the island of ___.
True or false: John says he was on that island because a storm wrecked his ship.

cards.text: On the Lord's day John is in the Spirit, and then he hears a loud voice like a trumpet. And it's coming from BEHIND him.

The voice tells John to write on a scroll what he sees and send it to seven churches: Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia and Laodicea. Then John turns to see the voice that was speaking with him.

cards.question: John turns and sees seven golden lampstands. How does John describe the One among them?

answers.text: One like the Son of Man

cards.text: He's dressed in a long robe, with a golden sash around His chest. Hang on, friend, the vision is just getting started.
His hair is white like wool, as white as snow, and His eyes are like a blazing fire. I've stared into a LOT of hot ovens, friend, and I don't think even I could hold that gaze.
His feet are like polished bronze refined in a furnace, and His voice is like the roar of many waters.
In His right hand He holds seven stars, and a sharp double-edged sword comes from His mouth.

cards.question: John says the face of the One like the Son of Man was like the ___ shining at its brightest.
John has just seen the One like the Son of Man. What does John do?

answers.text: Falls at His feet like a dead man
Covers his face and turns away
Grabs a scroll and starts writing

cards.question: The One like the Son of Man places His right hand on John. What does He say first?

cards.text: The One like the Son of Man calls Himself the First and the Last, the Living One. Then He says, “I was dead, and behold, now I am alive forever and ever!”

cards.question: The One like the Son of Man says He holds the keys of ___ and of Hades.
The One like the Son of Man tells John to write down the things he has seen. What else does He tell John to write down?

answers.text: The things that are and that will happen after this
The names of everyone in the seven churches
The words the old prophets spoke before him

cards.question: True or false: The One like the Son of Man says the seven golden lampstands are the seven churches.
The One like the Son of Man also explains the seven stars in His right hand. What are they?

answers.text: The angels of the seven churches
The seven spirits before His throne
The seven eyes of the LORD

cards.text: And that's where we'll stop for now, friend. This vision is NOT finished, not even close.
